title: Grof's book: discarnate aliens would show up as hallucinations
summary: Andrew Gallimore tells of Grof's book: discarnate aliens would show up as hallucinations, about unspecified at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Grath actually in one of his books he said look if if there are advanced intelligent beings you know aliens that are kind of non-physical discarnate

plain: Andrew Gallimore, a neuroscientist who studies the psychedelic drug DMT, tells Jesse Michels' podcast about an idea from a book by Stanislav Grof, a psychiatrist who studied altered states of mind. Gallimore says Grof argued that if advanced aliens exist without physical bodies, people would most likely encounter them as what look like hallucinations. If true, it would mean some visions could be real contact.
